references.text: David prophesied about Jesus' betrayal, which is related to the disciples abandoning Jesus.
The prophecy that the shepherd will be struck and the sheep scattered, reflecting the disciples' flight.
Isaiah's prophecy about the Messiah who would suffer and be forsaken, foreseeing the events in Gethsemane.
Jeremiah speaks of a time when shepherds (leaders) will be scattered, which can be seen as a parallel to the disciples' flight.
